record.question: In traditional Mizo society, which head ornament was worn only by men who killed an enemy?
record.explanation: Chhawn was the head ornament associated with the status of a warrior who had killed an enemy. The Mizoram University research account links eligibility for Ral-lu Lam with wearing Chhawn. Reference: https://mizostudiesmzu.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/06/Mizo-Studies-Oct.-Dec.2017.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
